summary: Completed comprehensive testing of bug fixes and features: (1) Filter sidebar padding/clipping fix verified - no content clipped, proper pb-6 pt-2 padding; (2) Make/model/submodel translation verified - 43 of 49 makes translated, 6 remain Korean due to exhausted LLM budget (expected, not a code defect); (3) 16 ads per page confirmed on both desktop and mobile; (4) Desktop ROW layout vs mobile CARD layout working correctly; (5) Sort control is native SELECT, defaults to price_asc, results properly ordered; (6) TrustStrip appears ABOVE taxonomy selects; (7) Insurance claim amounts converted to EUR (€2,695 shown for 4,459,873 KRW claim); (8) Detail page loads in 1.71s without stalling despite exhausted LLM budget (circuit breaker working); (9) All core flows functional.
